욥기 18:1.content: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

욥기 18:2.content: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

욥기 18:3.content: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

욥기 18:4.content: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

욥기 18:5.content: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

욥기 18:6.content: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

욥기 18:7.content: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

욥기 18:8.content: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

욥기 18:9.content: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

욥기 18:10.content: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

욥기 18:11.content: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

욥기 18:12.content: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

욥기 18:13.content: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

욥기 18:14.content: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

욥기 18:15.content: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

욥기 18:16.content: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

욥기 18:17.content: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

욥기 18:18.content: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

욥기 18:19.content: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

욥기 18:20.content: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

욥기 18:21.content: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
